items.title: Nvidia, AMD, and Micron stocks lead chip sector higher following worst sell-off since 2020
items.summary: Nvidia, AMD, Micron, and Sandisk rebounded on Friday after the chip sector suffered its worst daily drop since 2020.

items.title: What these CEOs think about the midterm election results
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi looks back on how business leaders are viewing the Democrats' midterm victories and whether it will affect their business. This includes commentary from Hilton Worldwide (HLT) CEO Chris Nassetta, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) CEO Lisa Su, and more executives who spoke to Yahoo Finance.

items.title: AI data centers face a higher bar–not a halt–after the blue wave
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down why the bar just got higher for data centers after the midterm elections, making it a topic to ask AMD (AMD) CEO Lisa Su, Intel (INTC) CEO Lip-Bu Tan, and Chicago Federal Reserve Bank president Austan Goolsbee about at Yahoo Finance Invest on Nov. 12.

items.title: Stocks lost $2 trillion. The market is wrong about AI
items.summary: The stock market lost $2 trillion in 40 minutes, and AI stocks took the worst of it, with Intel down more than half since October and AMD off 17% in a day. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why it happened and why he thinks the market is wrong, from GPU rental prices up 106% to the CPU boom and Anthropic's IPO valuation.

items.title: Stock market today: Nasdaq and S&P 500 rebound, Dow slips to cap bruising week for AI stocks
items.summary: Stocks are poised for steep weekly losses as a post-election rally turned into an artificial intelligence trade meltdown, sending tremors through markets.

items.title: Broadcom Is Still Down 22% in the Past Month: Is AVGO Stock Really on a Road to Recovery?
items.summary: While rival chipmakers bounce back from the midterm-driven selloff, Broadcom sits frozen despite triple-digit AI growth and a bargain multiple. What does the market see in its customers and margins that the earnings report doesn't?

items.title: Intel and AMD in Focus as Tech Stocks Seek Rebound
items.summary: Investors weighed a possible technology recovery ahead of the October U.S. jobs report.
